claims.statement: The core Makefile (repo://libs/core/Makefile) defines development targets including test, test_watch, test_profile, extended_tests for testing; format, lint, type, check_version, check_imports for code quality; and help for documentation. All targets run through uv run within virtual environments managed by uv, with UV_FROZEN=true preventing lock file changes. Testing targets unset tracing environment variables (LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2, LANGCHAIN_API_KEY, LANGSMITH_API_KEY, LANGSMITH_TRACING, LANGCHAIN_PROJECT) and disable network sockets except Unix sockets. The root libs/Makefile provides lock and check-lock targets that manage uv.lock files across core packages.
